description: This source file contains utility functions for processing weather forecast data, mapping weather codes to conditions, generating clothing recommendations based on forecast data, and providing mocked popular places for locations. It imports specific classes from src.api.main and defines multiple functions related to weather data interpretation and user guidance.

methods.name: str _weathercode_to_condition(code: int)
methods.description: Converts weather codes from Open-Meteo API to human-readable weather conditions.

methods.name: List[DailyForecast] map_open_meteo_to_daily_forecast(data: Dict)
methods.description: Transforms raw Open-Meteo weather data into a list of DailyForecast objects.

methods.name: List[str] _clothing_tips_for_day(day: DailyForecast)
methods.description: Generates clothing tips for a given day's forecast based on temperature, precipitation, and weather condition.

methods.name: List[ClothingRecommendation] get_clothing_recommendations_for_forecast(forecast: List[DailyForecast])
methods.description: Creates clothing recommendations for a list of DailyForecast objects.

methods.name: List[PopularPlace] mock_popular_places_for_city( city: str, country: str, )
methods.description: Provides a mocked list of popular places for a city, based on predefined samples or defaults.
